```cardsmith
card:
  system: dino-island
  card-type: taxonomy
  language: en
data:
  # The card's name. Falls back to the file name.
  name: Armoured walkers

  # An introductory sentence on the family, in italics (markdown).
  description: Armoured herbivores that would rather dig in than run.

  # The family's illustration on the back — a wikilink to a picture in the vault.
  image: '[[Panzerlaeufer.png]]'

  # Empty boxes to tick off with a pen. A number (`20`), a labelled row (`{ count: 20, label: Arrows }`) or a list of such rows. `group` (default 5) sets how many boxes stand together.
  tracker: # no sample

  # Source reference — rulebook page or wikilink, small at the foot.
  reference: Rulebook p. 46

  # "Occurrence (number)" — how and in what numbers the animals appear.
  occurrence: In pairs, the young between them

  # "Instinct" — the family's basic behaviour.
  instinct: Dig in and wait

  # "Moves" — the moves this family gives the game master; a list.
  moves:
    - Tail swipe
    - Bury the head in the sand
    - Refuse to be moved

  # "Genera" — example genera of the family.
  genera: Saichania, Pinacosaurus
```
